title: Design System: La Nube — Polo Tecnológico

display.purpose: Landing hero heading only — 'La Nube' as primary mark.

headline.purpose: Section headings on landing and dashboards. One gradient highlight word allowed.

title.purpose: Card headings, dialog titles, admin sidebar section labels.

body.purpose: All prose, form labels, table cells. Max 65–75ch.

label.purpose: System-voiced content: section kickers, status labels, timestamps, identifiers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button. Dark charcoal at rest; Observatory Blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #303030; color: #ffffff; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4e87c2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border: 1px solid #c8f1fc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200,241,252,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with hairline border; whisper fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: #424242; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f7f7f7; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: #c8f1fc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200,241,252,0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action in dense admin contexts. No border, hairline fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: #424242; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #eaeaea; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border: 1px solid #c8f1fc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200,241,252,0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Stroked border, focus glow in Ice Haze.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: #424242; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #888282; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #c8f1fc; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200,241,252,0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(239,68,68,0.15); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Standard container card. Flat at rest; Observatory Blue shadow on hover.
components.html:
Sala de Reuniones
Disponible de lunes a viernes, 9–18 h. Capacidad: 8 personas.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px 0 rgba(78,135,194,0.2); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #303030; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #888282; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-badge-default { background: #303030; color: #ffffff; } .ds-badge-outline { background: transparent; color: #424242; border-color: #eaeaea; } .ds-badge-secondary { background: #f7f7f7; color: #424242; border-color: #eaeaea; }

components.name: Mono Kicker
components.description: Section label voiced as a terminal path. One per screen. Deep Sky in light mode.
components.css: .ds-kicker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #2a6297; } .ds-kicker-cursor { margin-left: 1px; animation: ds-blink 1s step-end infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-kicker-cursor { animation: none; opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: Landing event card. Full-bleed cover image, stretched-link overlay at z-[1], CTA wrapper at z-[2].
components.html:
MAR · JUE
Taller de Arduino
components.css: .ds-event-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #eaeaea; background: #ffffff; transition: box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-event-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px 0 rgba(78,135,194,0.2); } .ds-event-card-cover { position: relative; } .ds-event-card-cover-placeholder { aspect-ratio: 16/10; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8ecf2 0%, #c8f1fc 100%); } .ds-event-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 20px; flex: 1; } .ds-event-card-meta { font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #2a6297; } .ds-event-card-title { font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #303030; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-event-card-cta { position: relative; z-index: 2; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 4px; } .ds-event-card-link { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; }

narrative.overview:
La Nube is a place where a community gathers to observe, explore, and build. The design system carries that identity: it is precise without being cold, local without being parochial, technical without being intimidating. Every surface should feel like it belongs to the people who use it — not to a vendor who packaged it for them.

The palette draws from the actual sky — a cornflower blue that reads as daytime, a signal cyan that hints at screens and broadcasts, a cool cloud-surface background that places you outdoors rather than inside a data centre. The system lives in both light and dark modes; dark mode shifts the metaphor from cloud to night sky, the night-station background anchoring an observatory aesthetic.

Typography is Roboto across the board — a humanist geometric sans-serif that carries both the warmth the community expects and the technical crispness the product needs. Roboto Mono plays a distinct role as the voice of the system itself: section kickers, timestamps, status labels, and the blinking cursor that greets visitors in the hero.
keyCharacteristics: Warm and local, but not folksy — confident and community-made
Blue carries identity, not just function — present at 30–50% of the surface, not decorative
The mono typeface is the system speaking; Roboto is the content speaking
Flat by default, alive on interaction — depth through state, not decoration
Admin surfaces are never punishing — the same visual warmth applies everywhere

rules.name: The Observatory Rule
rules.body: Observatory Blue must appear on every screen. It is the brand signal. A screen without it looks unbranded; a screen where it appears only in the footer has failed.

rules.name: The Signal Cyan Rule
rules.body: Signal Cyan is never used alone; it always appears in relation to Observatory Blue — as a gradient partner, a dark-mode counterpart, or a supporting accent.

rules.name: The Muted Floor
rules.body: #888282 is the floor for secondary text. Nothing dimmer on body copy.

rules.name: The Mono Voice Rule
rules.body: Roboto Mono is the system speaking. It appears on section kickers, status labels, form IDs, and timestamps — never on user-authored content.

rules.name: The One Gradient Word Rule
rules.body: In any given heading, at most one word or phrase receives the primary-to-secondary gradient. The gradient marks the concept — not the whole sentence.

rules.name: The Blue Shadow Rule
rules.body: When a card or interactive element is the primary content, its hover shadow is tinted Observatory Blue — not generic gray. The shadow carries the brand, not just depth.

rules.name: The Glass Boundary Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism is permitted only on the public navigation header. Nowhere else.

dos: Use Observatory Blue on every screen, in at least one prominent element.
Tint hover shadows with Observatory Blue (rgba(78,135,194,…)) on primary content cards.
Use Roboto Mono exclusively for system-generated, machine-voiced content.
Maintain 4.5:1 contrast for all body text.
Keep line length at 65–75ch for body copy.
Use text-wrap: balance on headings and text-wrap: pretty on multi-line paragraph copy.
Confine glassmorphism to the public navigation header.
donts: Don't build a WeWork or Regus surface — stock-photography hero, enterprise coldness, brand-as-status.
Don't build a university admin portal — no circa-2015 table-heavy UIs, no forms that feel punitive.
Don't use gradient text anywhere outside the Display hero heading and the one Headline highlight word.
Don't add a side-stripe border (colored border-left > 1px) to cards, alerts, or list items.
Don't use Muted (#888282) for body text below 18px.
Don't use box shadows as decoration at rest — shadow-sm is the max for resting admin cards.
Don't put a mono kicker above every section — one per screen.
Don't use generic dark-gray box shadows on interactive cards — tint with Observatory Blue.
